theorems.name: Submission.dgc_pm_lattice_tubes_disjoint
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (g₀ b b' : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (σ σ' : ℝ), dist b g₀ < 1 / 4 → dist b' g₀ < 1 / 4 → 0 < σ → σ < 1 / 4 → 0 < σ' → σ' < 1 / 4 → Disjoint (closedBall b σ) (closedBall b' σ') → Disjoint {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι | ∃ z : ι → ℤ, ∑ i, (y i - b i - z i) ^ 2 < σ ^ 2} {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι | ∃ z : ι → ℤ, ∑ i, (y i - b' i - z i) ^ 2 < σ' ^ 2}
